title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again | TechCrunch
summary: For those wary of using AI to fully hack their TVs, there are existing solutions for customizing Android-based smart TVs, such as home screen replacement apps ATV Launcher, Projectivy Launcher, and FLauncher.
